comment: The first run of the plain case. Four dockers open, the Colour Picker pinned, Tab, a switch to another program and the window's close, each of which saves the layout. `close` is the save the two make. The profile this leaves is what the second start, `focus-mode-left-on-at-a-close-gives-the-dockers-back-at-the-next-start`, opens on. Run this one first and that one after it, each through `sara_shot.py --scenario` with `--keep` into one folder.

The Colour Picker is moved by its title, 20 left and 30 down and so below the bar, which forks the shipped layout into the painter's own, so the file is the layout and not the shipped one. The Layers docker is closed from the Window menu, row 1, which leaves four open.
Tab. Only the pinned Colour Picker is left shown.
A switch to another program writes the layout, and the close writes it again. Waited past the start's 1500 milliseconds, which the unforced save is held back for.
